reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 25. Nay or No: 15. Not Voting: 0. posts.text:
Proud to participate in this year’s Florida Automated Vehicles Summit in Orlando, where we joined industry leaders to discuss the future of autonomous transportation.

We remain committed to advancing innovative transportation solutions that benefit our residents and thriving tourism industry.

UPDATE: A router mishap was the alleged cause of the FAA national ground stop. We will continue to seek more info, and push for necessary funding and reforms.

More info below: https://t.co/1WNeb6YG9x

I proudly voted to pass the Major Richard Star Act! This bipartisan bill eliminates the offset that forces roughly 59,000 medically retired, combat-injured veterans to give up military retirement pay to receive VA disability compensation.

We urge the Senate to pass this bill without delay!

I joined the Florida Delegation in urging President Trump to approve Governor DeSantis’s request for a Major Disaster Declaration following the severe flooding that recently impacted many counties, including Indian River, Okeechobee, Highlands, and more.

Federal assistance is https://t.co/VnB75Bx3NQ

I am monitoring the ground stop issued by the FAA in the interest of public safety. As we receive further information, we will publish updates.

We recognize this is disruptive to many families’ travel plans and will seek further information.
https://t.co/eT6qQ9seYk

It was a pleasure to welcome San Juan Mayor @Miguel_Romero_ to Washington this week.

We had a productive discussion on the critical issues impacting Puerto Rico, including job creation, healthcare, education, & ensuring the island receives the federal resources & support it needs.

House Democrats are ready to get to work for the American people in the 120th Congress! Thrilled to spend the week with new and returning colleagues. 

Time to lower costs, protect our care, stop corruption, and deliver for FL-9! https://t.co/udNpFoEXOK

House Democrats are ready to get to work for the American people in the 120th Congress! Thrilled to spend the week with new and returning colleagues. 

Time to lower costs, protect our care, stop corruption, and deliver for #FL9! https://t.co/9geiVyVVgI

Honored to welcome Florida @vfwhq to Congress this week. We discussed critical legislation to protect veterans' healthcare and secure benefits, including supporting the Major Richard Star Act.

Proud of our work to serve those who served. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/HIkNbFeats

This Veterans Day, we honor all who have served in our nation's armed forces. We owe our veterans a commitment to the healthcare, benefits, and support they deserve.

During the weekend, #TeamSoto proudly attended events in St. Cloud and Orlando to honor local veterans. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/UjUM8FWJzN

Happy 251st birthday to the @USMC!

Today reminds us of the courage and sacrifice shown by those who wear the uniform with honor. Thank you for your service! https://t.co/euHcDrmNsU

It was great to visit @AdventHealth in Sebring to learn more about their $130 million expansion, which will add over 100k square feet, 100 beds, and 200 staff members.

They are also investing in technology to improve their cardiovascular care in the community. https://t.co/6xwYBR1nEI

#TeamSoto had a great time at the Orlando Japan Festival in @CityofKissimmee! 🇺🇸🇯🇵

We got to experience beautiful dances, traditional Taiko drumming, martial arts demos, delicious cuisine, and more! https://t.co/mlEZ0jEXw9

Thrilled to attend MAX Power at @NASAKennedy this weekend to watch the air show, tech demonstrations, and new spaceflight hardware.

We must come together to support @NASA’s efforts to advance American space leadership and get back to the Moon, Mars, and beyond! 🇺🇸🚀💫 https://t.co/BsREwiYiZH
More pics! https://t.co/pdxqPLBqLt

Honored to attend the Veterans Day Parade hosted by @SaintCloudFLA today! We owe veterans a debt of gratitude and respect for our freedom and democracy. 

Proud to serve those who served! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/LlCCaCMhTc

We’ve recently visited several schools & after-school programs, including @tkhstigers, @OCSArts, @UCPofCFL, and the Boys & Girls Club.

We will continue delivering federal funds for education & after-school programs to help them make a meaningful difference in the lives of local https://t.co/hrNk7cAXi0

Recently, we met with seniors at Madison Grove in St. Cloud, @OsceolaCOA in Kissimmee, and other areas to hear the challenges they face.

We’re proud to strengthen Social Security, protect Medicare and Medicaid, and help secure millions for seniors affordable housing in FL-9! https://t.co/DV8G1D3e6R

Thanks to @OsceolaEOC for your briefing on flooding this morning! Indian River, Highlands, Okeechobee, Brevard and St Lucie were hit hard. 

The damage is extensive. Homes were flooded, some roads were washed out and other infrastructure was inundated. We will push for @fema relief.

Over the years, I've been proud to bring down billions of dollars to Central Florida to help boost high-paying jobs, fix the traffic, improve education, expand our world-class airports, upgrade public transportation, improve healthcare for veterans, and so much more! https://t.co/jyyOvfTU4m

TODAY IS ELECTION DAY. Time to make our voices heard!!! 🇺🇸 🗳️ 

Election Day Voting Info Here: https://t.co/GaX8i5pLZr https://t.co/v4CoPl5GKw

I am monitoring the flooding in Central Florida and further south. 

We remain ready to work with Florida and @fema on any necessary emergency response and relief efforts. https://t.co/0qIDf3vtZQ

GREATEST HITS: VISITING CATTLE COUNTRY 

In Congress, I'm proud to represent cattle country and work to improve farm income and SNAP, support disaster relief, and more to help our farmers, ranchers, and growers.

We are thankful to our cattle ranchers for helping feed America! https://t.co/JzqWCmfaTK

GREATEST HITS: SUPPORTING CITRUS

I visited citrus groves across Polk, Highlands, & Okeechobee to hear from growers about their challenges.

As they face greening, rising fertilizer & fuel costs, & natural disasters, I’m proud to deliver millions in funding to have their backs! https://t.co/ve67sF2dq9

Great to join the Hispanic Chamber of Commerce of Metro Orlando at @northbridge_eng for their Economic Exchange Forum!

This was a great chance to connect with business leaders, entrepreneurs, and others to discuss opportunities for economic growth in Central Florida. https://t.co/Q3RyY5emLm

GREATEST HITS: INDIAN RIVER LAGOON RESTORATION

We have helped deliver millions of dollars in ARP & Infrastructure Law funds to save the Indian River Lagoon.

After manatees were affected by an unusual mortality event, we secured grants to bring back seagrass & clean the river. https://t.co/pUB5FkNIfF

GREATEST HITS: LAKE TOHO RESTORATION

Proud to see that the North Lake Toho restoration is complete and the Big Lake Toho restoration has begun!

We're working with @USACEHQ and others on a $164M restoration of North and Big Lake Toho to reduce invasive plants and flooding. https://t.co/Q7HGWIA13N

I had the pleasure of honoring Vietnam War veteran Dr. Charles Robertson at @CityofStCloudFL.

Dr. Robertson's accomplishments reflect a lifetime of military service, professional leadership, business success, and commitment to his community. https://t.co/2In1nNvuQ9

GREATEST HITS: NEOCITY INVESTMENTS

Over the years, we have secured over $500 million to expand microchip manufacturing at NeoCity.

We are proud to see investments from companies worldwide that help create local jobs and boost our local economy. https://t.co/7I40SBfngY

GREATEST HITS: UCF NURSING SCHOOL

Central Florida faces a rapidly growing nursing shortage. I’m proud to have opened a new @UCF_Nursing school in Lake Nona that will welcome 200+ nurses to their programs every semester! https://t.co/eP3xft7shp

Honored to join @IaccOrlando in celebrating Diwali with the City of Orlando!

A beautiful celebration of light, love, unity, and the rich traditions that bring our communities together. May this Festival of Lights inspire hope, happiness, prosperity, and new beginnings for all. https://t.co/gGybMzVHTY

We visited Madison Grove Senior Living Community in St. Cloud to hear from residents.

From strengthening Social Security and protecting Medicare/Medicaid to building affordable housing, we are committed to protecting the benefits, dignity, and quality of life our seniors deserve.

GREATEST HITS: LAKE NONA VA EXPANSION 🏥 

Proud of our work to expand Lake Nona @OVAHCS, adding primary care clinical space, SimVet research, and an Academic Center.

We remain dedicated to ensuring our veterans receive the care and support they deserve. https://t.co/xXYOYw0PwN

GREATEST HITS: ADVANCING NASA LEGISLATION

I’m proud to have worked with @NASA on space legislation over the last few years. 🚀  Our bipartisan Launch Communications Act is helping streamline commercial launches at Cape Canaveral & others! https://t.co/pZcEDhVZHB https://t.co/m79YCuwAWq

GREATEST HITS: LYNX FUNDING 

We proudly secured a $9.2 million FTA grant to rehabilitate @lynxbusorlando buses. 

We have also secured $1 million in Community Project funding for bus pullouts and safety enhancements, and worked to build the new Osceola Terminal.

GREATEST HITS: SUNRAIL EXPANSION

Thanks to the bipartisan Infrastructure Law, we’re working to expand @RideSunRail to @MCO and theme parks, and @GoBrightline to Tampa.

Proud of our work to expand transit options & connect our communities.
https://t.co/ymsxaGX3B1

Thrilled to attend Game 5 of the World Series. It’s all on the line.

Let’s go Rays!!! #RaysUp https://t.co/64eGfgrasV

GREATEST HITS: KISSIMMEE GATEWAY AIRPORT EXPANSION

We recently helped secure over $21 million for @FlyKissimmee to rehabilitate taxiways, plus $10 million for a new air traffic control tower. https://t.co/z3COIUVKSu

GREATEST HITS: OSCEOLA PROSPER

Osceola Prosper has given so many local students the chance to attend @ValenciaCollege & @weareoTECH, as @OsceolaCountyFl has skyrocketed to the #4 spot in FL for college enrollment.

Proud to help secure #ARP federal funding for this program!

GREATEST HITS: I-4 EXPANSION

We’re proud to have helped secure nearly half of the $3.5 billion needed to advance this critical investment.

The I-4 expansion will widen the interstate to 10 lanes, helping ease congestion & improve commutes for millions of Central Floridians.

Honored to attend the Dominican Chamber of Commerce of Florida's first anniversary gala, where I had the opportunity to connect with local small business owners, entrepreneurs, and leaders.

We remain committed to uplifting our Dominican community in Central Florida! 🇺🇸🇩🇴 https://t.co/CuO27Pedf4

We congratulate @NeoCityAcademy student Araoluwakiitan Afolabi of St. Cloud for winning 2nd place at the national Civics Bee Competition!

It’s inspiring to see our next generation of leaders demonstrate such a strong commitment to civic engagement.
https://t.co/4axaraq2So

Great to attend the ribbon-cutting ceremony for @OsceolaCountyFl’s first-ever Tech Library! 

Just a few minutes from NeoCity, this library will serve as an innovative hub to broaden access to education and technology. https://t.co/WQ7BgFOoKY

#TeamSoto hosted our U.S. Service Academy interviews this morning! We are immensely proud of these young people for aspiring to serve our country.

Thank you to our Veterans Advisory Board members for interviewing these amazing applicants. https://t.co/sNYBCg4Xr5

We visited @havikvr to explore their portable, high-fidelity VR/AR training systems for the U.S. military, NATO, & special operations forces.

Investments in this cutting-edge technology support our troops, improve readiness & training, & create high-quality Central Florida jobs. https://t.co/98Uh9kDPT3

We joined @LakeNonaRCC at the NHIT Community Health Innovation Summit to connect with leaders shaping the future of health care.

We are improving clinical trials, expanding women and minority health research, developing cures, and boosting our Central Florida economy. https://t.co/ziNKj6wTjM

On Monday, we had the pleasure of watching "The President's Own" @marineband perform at @DrPhillipsCtr.

Honored to witness this incredible ensemble at home! https://t.co/L5r13DXBQi
Congrats to @RaysBaseball on your BIG win last night! Good luck in the World Series. #RaysUp https://t.co/HMp9ZPIosR

It was an honor to attend the Dr. Phillips Charities Impact Awards Ceremony, which recognizes organizations creating opportunities, strengthening our community, and helping people across Central Florida! https://t.co/eOzgYIuE0Z
Orange Early Voting Info: https://t.co/B1jpz6F1J0 https://t.co/P0XcciVyzA

EARLY VOTE STARTS TODAY in Orange and Osceola Counties. Time to make your voices heard! 🇺🇸 🗳️ 

Osceola Voting Info: https://t.co/0RdDpZR9kK https://t.co/jop5r2sGYo

Last week, I met with members of the @LIUNA laborers' union at their Walt Disney World worksite.

We are grateful for their efforts to advance local infrastructure and keep Central Florida moving forward! https://t.co/gxOPxzfI73

On Friday, #TeamSoto visited the Global Produce and Floral Show with @IntFreshProduce. 

We discussed the challenges our growers face, including tariffs, labor shortages, rising costs, and recent freezes. Proud to support our fresh produce industry in Central Florida! https://t.co/qMUQFuoYDg

Last night, we hosted a Firefighter Appreciation event to honor outstanding individuals who help keep Central Florida safe. 🚒

I am proud of our efforts to protect them through federal SAFER grants, the Social Security Fairness Act, and our PFAS Injury Compensation Act. https://t.co/CbCUJ5uWcs

Today, our office received an envelope with a suspicious substance.

Thankfully, Congressman Frost’s office gave us advance notice to monitor our mail. The envelope was intercepted by local law enforcement, and no staff was hurt.

We are working with federal, state, and local law https://t.co/BONSFdL1yy

Great to meet with local veterans at @VFWHQ 3227 in St. Cloud. We discussed our recent Service Academy Day, the Lake Nona VA’s new women’s clinic and cardiology expansion, and our veterans’ constituent services.

I am proud to serve those who have served. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/pCl5HTeUGp

This week, I had the opportunity to tour the Grifols Plasma Center in Kissimmee to learn more about plasma-derived therapies for rare and chronic conditions.

With 20+ centers in Central Florida, they also employ hundreds of medical professionals in the area. https://t.co/1sD96iH1RS

This is absolutely unacceptable. Hate has no place in America. The FBI must investigate.

Theses attacks against the Indian American community must stop. https://t.co/XzXW6UW9zj

I visited @tkhstigers to recognize our outstanding students who earned 1st, 2nd, and 6th place nationally in the 2026 U.S. Adobe Certified Professional Championship!

It’s always inspiring to see the next generation of leaders showcasing their creativity and dedication. https://t.co/9K2ldYHT0x

During #HispanicHeritageMonth, Team Soto was honored to celebrate the exceptional leaders making a lasting difference across Central Florida.

From labor leaders & educators to law enforcement professionals & entrepreneurs, these individuals exemplify the power of leadership & https://t.co/6111GR190m

I recently joined a bipartisan group of my Florida colleagues in the House to reintroduce the RAISE Act—legislation to streamline the process for disaster relief for our local farmers & growers to help them recover quickly & continue feeding America. 

After the devastating https://t.co/eCt4mwII7v

UPDATE: We pray for the families of 4 hurricane victims who were killed, and a quick recovery for those injured.

We also thank our first responders for your heroism, including those from Central Florida who traveled north to help with the response. Your actions saved lives.

We stand ready to support @fema as they help our fellow Americans in North Florida, Alabama and Georgia affected by Hurricane Isaiah. This Cat-2 storm caused major property damage and widespread power outages.
 https://t.co/p3dkoFxRe8

Great to attend the Orange @FlaFarmBureau Board Installation Dinner.

Proud to represent citrus and cattle country in Congress and work to combat citrus greening, improve farm income and SNAP, support disaster relief, and more to help our farmers, ranchers, and growers. https://t.co/rpRepFfci6

Thank you to @OsceolaEOC for the Hurricane #Isaias pre-landfall briefing.

In Central Florida, we have a tornado watch with some rain expected tonight. Please stay informed. We stand ready to support @fema to help our region, N Fla and other affected areas. https://t.co/whjnVcK8SK

Welcome back to earth Crew-12!

We are proud of NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway as well as ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot and cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev! 🇺🇸 

Your efforts are forging critical space and medical research and more. https://t.co/HremJJgxq3

We are actively monitoring Hurricane #Isaias today. It’s expected to make landfall in the Fl Panhandle late Friday / early Saturday morning as a potential Category 2.

This course could change so Central Floridians need to prepare and keep informed as the storm continues to move. https://t.co/TUkWbmlco4

Last week, I attended the annual F-35 Congressional Cockpit event, which highlighted developments in the aerospace and defense technologies sector.

Central Florida is leading the way in aerospace and simulation technology, and I'm proud to continue supporting these efforts. https://t.co/QWxAvxEEzK

Proud to see that the North Lake Toho restoration is complete and the Big Lake Toho restoration has begun!

We're working with @USACEHQ & others on a $164M restoration of North & Big Lake Toho to reduce invasive plants & flooding & protect water supply, recreation, and wildlife. https://t.co/xxgvy51qHK

Proud to secure $1 million in U.S. DOJ funds for the @OsceolaSheriff Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force through our FY26 Community Project Funding requests.

This will help them acquire resources to protect Central Florida children from predatory behavior online. https://t.co/Hx0zALslZK

We pray for those lost and for a quick recovery for those injured in the Winter Haven school bus crash today. 

Thank you to our first responders for your life saving response. https://t.co/HMiCgSHH9u

VOTER REGISTRATION DEADLINE is TODAY - OCT 5TH. FL-9 Citizens can register to vote online here: https://t.co/qnhflbKWI6

VBM’s just dropped. Early vote starts in 2 weeks. Election Day is Nov 3rd. Make your voices heard! 🇺🇸 🗳️ https://t.co/y4mczIJK2R

Proud to support our local firefighters! I just introduced the Firefighter PFAS Injury Compensation Act of 2026—to help firefighters and families who have suffered from PFAS-related conditions. 

We will always have your backs! https://t.co/kuf2bH440R
